subject: Reflections on Service and City Priorities
overview: Medford City Councilor Justin Tseng reflected on balancing his college studies with serving on the council and discussed his priorities for the city.

items.title: Reflections on Service and City Priorities
items.summary: Justin Tseng outlined his motivations for running for office as a student and highlighted his focus on racial equity, climate change, school improvements, and housing affordability.
